fact: The Maluana Science and Technology Park, inaugurated in 2014, hosted incubation services and tenant company Edutech Lda. until the state park company ENPCT was extinguished in 2026.
title: Extinção da ENPCT: “As decisões políticas em Moçambique não são guiadas por um estudo prévio”, defende Julião Cumbane, antigo PCA
